BookingOrder.title: Booking Order
BookingOrder.description: Base order/agreement primitive. Concrete kinds (booking, sales, purchase, grant, engagement, quote, blanket) discriminate via `orderType` and extend with their own tail; payments (deposits, disbursements) and lines are related objects (Payment / OrderLine), not fields. Booking orders (orderType=booking) keep the completed → invoiced lifecycle: on completion a final Invoice is materialised and linked via invoiceId; on cancellation after invoicing a reversing CreditNote is materialised (REQ-DI-001/002).

orderType.description: Discriminator selecting the order kind + lifecycle. Existing rows default to 'booking'.
orderType.title: Order Type

direction.description: incoming (we receive/are awarded) vs outgoing (we issue/award).
direction.title: Direction

orderNumber.description: Human reference (PO / quote / grant / booking number).
orderNumber.title: Order Number

counterpartyId.description: Supplier / customer / grantee / contractor party id (generalises customerId).
counterpartyId.title: Counterparty ID

totalAmount.description: Headline amount (order total / awarded amount / engagement value).
totalAmount.title: Total Amount

projectReference.description: Optional project this order is for.
projectReference.title: Project Reference

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this order for tenant isolation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

orderId.description: Operator-assigned unique order identifier within the administration.
orderId.title: Order ID

bookingTypeId.description: FK to the booking type that priced this order.
bookingTypeId.title: Booking Type ID

customerId.description: FK identifying the customer. A customer is a Nextcloud contact entity (ADR: contacts are NC entities), not a bespoke schema; this is the shared external reference.
customerId.title: Customer ID

description.description: Human-readable description of the booked service, used as the service invoice line description.
description.title: Description

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Final invoicing is EUR-only in this tier (multi-currency is out of scope).
currency.title: Currency

basePrice.description: Net service price in minor currency units (EUR cents), excluding VAT.
basePrice.title: Base Price

taxRate.description: VAT percentage applied to the service line (21 standard, 9 reduced, 0 exempt) per REQ-DI-004.
taxRate.title: Tax Rate

estimatedTotal.description: Estimated gross total in minor units at confirmation time. Informational.
estimatedTotal.title: Estimated Total

depositRequired.description: Whether a deposit rule applies to this order. When false, the final invoice carries no credit line (REQ-DI-008).
depositRequired.title: Deposit Required

depositAmount.description: Authorised deposit amount in minor units (EUR cents), credited on the final invoice (REQ-DI-003).
depositAmount.title: Deposit Amount

depositPaymentId.description: FK to the DepositPayment that holds the authorised deposit (bookings-deposits T1).
depositPaymentId.title: Deposit Payment ID

paymentTermsDays.description: Net payment terms in days used to compute the final invoice due date (REQ-DI-005).
paymentTermsDays.title: Payment Terms Days

invoiceId.description: FK to the final Invoice created on completion. Null until completed; set by the complete transition action (REQ-DI-001/002).
invoiceId.title: Invoice ID

completedAt.description: Timestamp the booking was fulfilled/completed. Must be set before invoicing (REQ-DI-002).
completedAt.title: Completed At

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Order created, not yet priced or confirmed.

pending_payment.label: Pending payment
pending_payment.description: Awaiting deposit authorisation when a deposit rule applies (bookings-deposits).

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.description: Booked and confirmed; deposit (if any) authorised. Awaiting fulfilment.

completed.label: Completed
completed.description: Fulfilled/checked out. A final Invoice has been materialised in Shillinq and linked via invoiceId (REQ-DI-002).

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: Cancelled. If a final Invoice was already issued, a reversing CreditNote was materialised (REQ-DI-006). Remains queryable for audit.

confirm.label: Confirm order
confirm.description: Confirm once the deposit (if required) is authorised.

confirmDirect.label: Confirm order (no deposit)
confirmDirect.description: Confirm an order that requires no deposit.

complete.label: Complete order
complete.description: Operator confirms fulfilment/checkout. Gated by InvoiceFromBookingGuard (completedAt set, deposit authorised, not already invoiced) then materialises exactly one final Invoice with service + deposit-credit lines, linking Order.invoiceId back (REQ-DI-002, idempotent per REQ-DI-002).

actions.description: Materialise exactly one final Invoice (with InvoiceLine children: a service line at the order tax rate and, when a deposit is authorised, a negative 0%-VAT deposit-credit line) and set Order.invoiceId. Declarative outcome per REQ-DI-002/003/004 — line amounts and the deposit credit are computed by InvoiceFromBookingGuard before persistence.

cancelConfirmed.label: Cancel order
cancelConfirmed.description: Cancel a confirmed order that was never invoiced. No CreditNote needed.

cancelAfterInvoice.label: Cancel invoiced order
cancelAfterInvoice.description: Cancel after a final Invoice was issued. Gated by BookingCancellationGuard and materialises exactly one reversing CreditNote against the linked Invoice (REQ-DI-006, idempotent).

actions.description: Materialise exactly one CreditNote reversing the linked Invoice for the full invoice gross. Declarative outcome per REQ-DI-006; amounts computed by BookingCancellationGuard. The original Invoice is preserved.

countByState.description: Number of orders per lifecycle state.

DepositPayment.title: Deposit Payment
DepositPayment.description: An authorised booking deposit (owned by bookings-deposits T1). Declared here as a dimension so deposit-to-invoice can resolve the authorised amount for the credit line (REQ-DI-003) and so cancellation can transition it to refunded (REQ-DI-006). The full collection/state machine lives in bookings-deposits.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this deposit for tenant isolation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

orderId.description: FK to the Order this deposit was collected for.
orderId.title: Order ID

amount.description: Authorised deposit amount in minor currency units (EUR cents).
amount.title: Amount

arInvoiceId.description: FK to the deposit AR invoice created at collection time (bookings-deposits T1).
arInvoiceId.title: AR Invoice ID

refundPolicy.description: Whether the deposit is automatically refunded on cancellation.
refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: A final customer invoice materialised in Shillinq when a booking order completes. Carries a service line and, when a deposit was authorised, a negative deposit-credit line. Bidirectionally linked to its Order via sourceDocumentUri and to the credited DepositPayment via depositPaymentId (REQ-DI-001). Integrates into Shillinq AR aging with no special handling (REQ-DI-009).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this invoice for tenant isolation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

invoiceNumber.description: Human-readable invoice number (Dutch: factuurnummer), prefix INV-YYYY-NNNNN.
invoiceNumber.title: Invoice Number

customerId.description: FK to the customer (Nextcloud contact entity) from the source order.
customerId.title: Customer ID

orderId.description: FK back to the source Order, mirroring sourceDocumentUri for convenient querying.
orderId.title: Order ID

invoiceDate.description: Date the invoice was issued (typically the completion date).
invoiceDate.title: Invoice Date

sourceDocumentUri.description: Reference to the originating Order: urn:nextcloud:booking:order:{orderId} (REQ-DI-001). Also serves as the idempotency key for invoice materialisation (REQ-DI-002).
sourceDocumentUri.title: Source Document URI

depositPaymentId.description: FK to the DepositPayment credited on this invoice (REQ-DI-001).
depositPaymentId.title: Deposit Payment ID

netAmount.description: Total amount excluding VAT, in minor units. Service net only (the deposit credit is gross, post-VAT).
netAmount.title: Net Amount

vatAmount.description: Total VAT in minor units. Charged on the service line only; the deposit credit carries 0% VAT (REQ-DI-004).
vatAmount.title: VAT Amount

grossAmount.description: Total amount due after the deposit credit is applied, in minor units (REQ-DI-003).
grossAmount.title: Gross Amount

state.description: Invoice lifecycle state. Created as issued; AR owns the onward lifecycle.
state.title: State

countByState.description: Number of invoices per state for AR aging dashboards (REQ-DI-009).

InvoiceLine.title: Invoice Line
InvoiceLine.description: A single line on a final Invoice: either a positive service line (taxed at the order rate) or a negative deposit-credit line (0% VAT, because the deposit was already taxed at collection) per REQ-DI-003/004.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this line for tenant isolation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

lineNumber.description: Ordinal position of the line on the invoice.
lineNumber.title: Line Number

lineType.description: Whether this is the service line or the deposit credit line.
lineType.title: Line Type

description.description: Line description shown to the customer.
description.title: Description

unitPrice.description: Net unit price in minor units. Negative for the deposit credit line.
unitPrice.title: Unit Price

lineAmount.description: Net line amount (quantity * unitPrice) in minor units. Negative for the deposit credit line.
lineAmount.title: Line Amount

taxRate.description: VAT percentage applied to this line. 0 for the deposit credit line (REQ-DI-004).
taxRate.title: Tax Rate

taxAmount.description: VAT amount in minor units. 0 for the deposit credit line.
taxAmount.title: Tax Amount

grossAmount.description: Gross line amount (lineAmount + taxAmount) in minor units. Negative for the deposit credit line.
grossAmount.title: Gross Amount

CreditNote.title: Credit Note
CreditNote.description: A reversing credit note materialised in Shillinq when a booking is cancelled after its final Invoice was issued. Reverses the full invoice gross while preserving the original invoice for audit (REQ-DI-006). Does not create negative VAT entries.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this credit note for tenant isolation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

creditNoteNumber.description: Human-readable credit note number, prefix CN-YYYY-NNNNN.
creditNoteNumber.title: Credit Note Number

linkedInvoiceId.description: FK to the Invoice being reversed. Also the idempotency key (one CreditNote per invoice) per REQ-DI-006.
linkedInvoiceId.title: Linked Invoice ID

customerId.description: FK to the customer (Nextcloud contact entity).
customerId.title: Customer ID

creditDate.description: Date the credit note was issued.
creditDate.title: Credit Date

grossAmount.description: Credit gross in minor units; the full reversal of the linked invoice gross (REQ-DI-006).
grossAmount.title: Gross Amount
